params.prompt: Game prop texture, a single image that fills the whole canvas edge to edge, no border, no frame, no text, no watermark. An old family snapshot photograph: a Korean construction worker in his late thirties wearing a white safety helmet and a dusty work vest, smiling widely with crinkled eyes at a building site, scaffolding and concrete behind him, natural daylight, framed from the chest up, amateur snapshot composition.
